## Distinguish the main program uses

The [SBA 7(a) program](https://www.sba.gov/loans/7a-loans/) lists machinery and equipment among potential uses and also includes working capital. That breadth can make it relevant to a mixe

ose proposal, subject to eligibility and underwriting. It does not mean every expense in a supplier package is automatically approved.

The [SBA 504 program](https://www.sba.gov/loans/504-loans/) focuses on qualifying major fixed assets and involves a Certified Development Company. Its equipment criteria include useful rema

ship, contribution and credit requirements. Avoid relying on a universal percentage taken from an old article.
